dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Predominantly closed-loop 'O' and partial 'C' shapes characterized by sharp light-colored perimeters enclosing darker interior centers, primarily distributed across the mid-dorsal and lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light-colored pixel clusters without internal gradients, interspersed between the larger macro-annuli in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent circular annuli located in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse triangle relative to the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region displays a transition from high-contrast dorsal patterning to a more uniform, low-intensity dark texture with minimal visible markings.
